competitor.summary: There are 3,241 coffee shops in NYC and 34% are chains, led by Dunkin and Starbucks. Busy areas with few cafés, like Elmhurst, are the openings to look for; areas like Hell's Kitchen are crowded.

operations.role: Studies what successful cafés do right and what gets cafés in trouble (health grades, closures).
operations.summary: Successful cafés keep their A grade (95% do), control pests and check fridge temperatures daily. 4% of coffee shops were closed by the Health Department at least once, and 66% of those had pest problems: the easiest failure to avoid.

findings.text: 95% of NYC coffee shops hold an A health grade.
findings.sql: SELECT AVG(grade='A') FROM cafes WHERE segment='coffee' AND grade IS NOT NULL
SELECT AVG(grade='A') FROM cafes WHERE segment='coffee' AND grade IS NOT NULL AND chain=0

findings.text: 4% of coffee shops were temporarily closed by the Health Department at least once in the last few years.
findings.sql: SELECT AVG(dohmh_closures>0) FROM cafes WHERE segment='coffee'

findings.text: 66% of the 119 coffee shops closed by inspectors had a pest problem (mice, roaches, flies or gaps that let pests in) at that inspection.
findings.sql: SELECT 1.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.violation_code IN ('04K','04L','04M','04N','08A') THEN v.camis END)/COUNT(DISTINCT v.camis) FROM violations v JOIN cafes c USING(camis) WHERE c.segment='coffee' AND v.closure=1

findings.text: Most common serious problem: surfaces not cleaned and sanitised properly (found at 1,864 coffee shops).
findings.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.camis) FROM violations v JOIN cafes c USING(camis) WHERE c.segment='coffee' AND v.critical_flag='Critical' AND v.violation_code='06D'

top_violations.description: Food contact surface not properly washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use and following any activity when contamination may have occurred.
top_violations.tip: Surfaces not cleaned and sanitised properly: sanitise after every use.

top_violations.description: Food not protected from potential source of contamination during storage, preparation, transportation, display or service.
top_violations.tip: Food not protected: cover food, use sneeze guards, label containers.

top_violations.description: Cold TCS food item held above 41 °F; smoked or processed fish held above 38 °F; intact raw eggs held above 45 °F; or reduced oxygen packaged (ROP) TCS foods held above required temperatures except during active necessary preparation.
top_violations.tip: Cold food too warm: keep milk and cold items at 41°F or below; check fridges daily.

top_violations.description: Filth flies or food/refuse/sewage associated with (FRSA) flies or other nuisance pests  in  establishment’s food and/or non-food areas. FRSA flies include house flies, blow flies, bottle flies, flesh flies, drain flies, Phorid flies and fruit flies.
top_violations.tip: Flies: screens, closed bins, clean drains.

top_violations.description: Evidence of mice or live mice in establishment's food or non-food areas.
top_violations.tip: Mice: seal gaps, store food off the floor, use a licensed pest-control service.

top_violations.description: Food Protection Certificate (FPC) not held by manager or supervisor of food operations.
top_violations.tip: No Food Protection Certificate holder on duty: make sure a certified manager is always on shift.

top_violations.description: Wiping cloths not stored clean and dry, or in a sanitizing solution, between uses.
top_violations.tip: Wiping cloths left out: keep them in sanitising solution between uses.

top_violations.description: Hot TCS food item not held at or above 140 °F.
top_violations.tip: Hot food not hot enough: hold hot food at 140°F or above.

lessons.title: Keep an A grade from day one
lessons.text: 95% of coffee shops have an A. Customers see the grade in the window, so a B or C puts you behind most competitors.

lessons.title: Pests are the top reason cafés get shut
lessons.text: 66% of the coffee shops the Health Department closed had a pest problem at that inspection. A pest-control contract and sealing gaps around pipes and doors are must-haves.

lessons.title: Chains run tight processes; independents can too
lessons.text: Chains hold A grades 98% of the time vs 94% for independents. Daily checklists (fridge temperatures, cleaning, pest checks) close that gap.

lessons.title: Don't open where it's already crowded
lessons.text: Areas with few riders per café split the same customers many ways. Look for busy streets that have few cafés (see the map).
